backlogged.summary: Rows with a missing or unparseable ended_at are silently dropped by `--since` (NaN comparison is false). Rule (a) sorts them as time 0. A hand-edited metrics line that is valid JSON but lacks fields still counts toward `lines` without any warning. ES-1 only covers non-object lines.

`harness stats --json` with no metrics files prints the plain text 'no metrics yet' instead of a JSON document. This follows ES-2 literally, but it means machine consumers of --json must special-case this output.
Metrics files grow without bound and `harness stats` re-reads every file on each call. There is no rotation or pruning; --since only filters at aggregation time.

Rule (c) checks only that features.json contains any standard-tier feature. It does not check whether the builder cost actually came from standard features, so the suggestion can appear when the cost is driven by critical features.
